title: Prambanan & Ratu Boko Enterprise Point of Sale (POS)
subtitle: Cashier & Multi-Warehouse ERP System across UNESCO Heritage Complex
role: IT Development and Data Management Intern
description: Enterprise point-of-sale ecosystem built for Prambanan and Ratu Boko units to connect live data with company ERP, featuring multi-warehouse inventory mutations and direct Bluetooth thermal ESC/POS printing.
overview: Assisted in engineering the Point-of-Sale (POS) and retail management system for Prambanan F&B and ticketing units under PT Taman Wisata Candi Borobudur, Prambanan & Ratu Boko (TWC / InJourney). The system connects cashier transactions directly with the enterprise ERP for financial audit and inventory tracking. Built with Laravel 13, Inertia.js, and React 19, paired with a Capacitor Android native bridge for direct Bluetooth Classic (SPP) ESC/POS thermal printing to BP-LITE80D printers with zero browser dialog delay. Handles multi-warehouse inventory, cashier shift reconciliation, and cashier payment method classification toggles for accounting administration.
keyFeatures: Native Android Bluetooth Classic (SPP) ESC/POS printing bridge eliminating print dialog delays (<0.5s auto-cut)
Automated data sync with company ERP for end-of-day audit accuracy
Multi-Warehouse Inventory Architecture tracking real-time stock mutations, transfers, and FEFO batch allocations
Cashier Shift Lifecycle engine with cash float verification, drawer reconciliation, and detailed audit logs
Cashier Payment Method Classification: Quick toggles (Cash, QRIS, Bank Transfer, Open-Bill) to categorize transactions for accurate end-of-shift reconciliation and finance administration
Role-based access control via Spatie, password step-up verification, and login rate limiting

description: Internal enterprise scheduling platform utilized by PT Taman Wisata Candi to coordinate multi-day venue bookings, load-in setup windows, and tiered seating layouts without double-booking conflicts.
overview: Designed and developed an internal web enterprise platform for PT Taman Wisata Candi Borobudur, Prambanan & Ratu Boko (TWC / InJourney). It features an atomic scheduling validation engine that accounts for multi-phase windows (load-in setup, main event, and tear-down unload) to eliminate scheduling collisions, coupled with an interactive seat allocation module and destination-scoped user permissions.

Dynamic Seating Chart Management (`kursi`) with row-and-column tier mapping for Ramayana Ballet Prambanan stages
Destination-scoped Role-Based Access Control (Sales scoped to single sites; Admins manage cross-destination bookings)
Client reservation history, PIC assignment workflow, and per-user notification read-state tracking
Modern, fast enterprise UI built with Laravel 13, Blade Components, Tailwind CSS 4, and Vite

title: Bandung Urban Traffic Density Estimation via YOLOv11 & DeepSORT
subtitle: Computer Vision Research Defense at Telkom University (School of Computing)
description: Fine-tuned YOLOv11 and DeepSORT pipeline trained on 21,277 vehicle instances across 17 municipal CCTV locations (Pelindung Bandung) for real-time motorcycle and car density tracking with 98.1% counting accuracy.
overview: Undergraduate research and engineering defense at Telkom University supervised by Dr. Edward Ferdian and Dr. Ema Rachmawati. Solved the critical limitation of conventional traffic detection models that fail in motorcycle-dominant Southeast Asian urban centers. Built an automated dataset extraction engine using Python + Selenium to sample 17 municipal CCTV feeds from Pelindung Bandung, annotated 1,515 frames across peak hours, applied directional flipping and grain injection augmentations, and fine-tuned YOLOv11 + DeepSORT. Achieved 65.5% mAP@50 (vs 12.1% baseline YOLOv11) with an 87.5x increase in motorcycle recall (70.0% vs 0.8%), reaching 98.1% real-world counting accuracy in light traffic and 85.0% in heavy congestion.
keyFeatures: Automated Municipal CCTV Pipeline: Custom Python + Selenium crawler extracting temporal frames every 10s from 17 Bandung Government CCTV locations
Domain-Specific Dataset Curation: 1,515 annotated frames (21,277 vehicle instances; 62.5% motorcycles, 37.5% cars) with noise injection and horizontal flip augmentations
YOLOv11 + DeepSORT Tracking Architecture: Bounded 640x640 real-time inference with Kalman filtering and appearance association across virtual counting lines
87.5x Motorcycle Recall Surge: Reached 70.0% recall and 79.5% precision on test set, cutting baseline false negative rate from 99.2% to 30.0%
Cross-City Generalization: Validated across 8 additional Bandung intersections (Gasibu, Pasteur, Jalaprang) and cross-city footage with 92.2% accuracy

title: FaveHotel Laundry & Inventory Mobile App

title: Console-Based Library Management System
subtitle: Object-Oriented System with Role-Based Access Control
description: Console application implementing Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and custom data structures for multi-role library cataloging, borrowing, and inventory management.
overview: Built as an intensive academic project to demonstrate practical application of core OOP principles (polymorphism, encapsulation, inheritance, abstraction) and memory-efficient data structures. Features dual-role permissions (Administrator and Guest), transaction ledger records, author-indexed search trees, and comprehensive input validation.
keyFeatures: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) separating administrative stock control from guest search and borrowing
Dynamic catalog searching indexed by author, ISBN, category, and availability
Transaction tracking module with due-date calculation and return validation
Input sanitization and exception handling to prevent runtime errors
Architectural user manual detailing system class diagrams
